edges.label: SCU's inaugural Distinguished Scholar Award, June 2025 - recognition, not an office
edges.note: Presented at SCU's Sixth Annual Conference, Von Braun Center, Huntsville, Alabama, 6-8 June 2025, by SCU Executive Board member Rich Hoffman, who said: 'Dr. Knuth's leadership in advancing empirical, interdisciplinary UAP research exemplifies the mission of SCU.' IMPORTANT SCOPE LIMIT: this pass found no evidence that Knuth holds an SCU board seat, officer post or executive role. The board's pre-existing SCU connection to this cluster runs through Robert Powell, an SCU founding board member and Knuth's co-author on the 2019 Entropy paper. The award is a recognition edge, and is labelled as one.
